nebbiolo.summary: Nebbiolo often changes dramatically with bottle age: primary cherry and rose recede while savory, earthy and dried-fruit notes emerge and the tannin feels less angular.

stages.label: Young
stages.effect: Rose, sour cherry and high-toned red fruit sit over formidable tannin and bright acidity; tar and herbal notes can already be present.

stages.label: Developing
stages.effect: Tannin begins to knit together as dried cherry, leather, tobacco and truffle become more prominent.

stages.label: Mature
stages.effect: Fruit shifts toward dried and preserved tones, with tar, forest-floor, leather and spice taking a larger role; structure is usually more integrated.

nebbiolo.vintage: Warmer vintages can show riper fruit and earlier approachability, while cooler vintages often emphasize acidity, perfume and a slower evolution. Producer and vineyard remain major variables.

cabernet-sauvignon.summary: Cabernet-led Bordeaux commonly moves from cassis, cedar and firm structure toward tobacco, leather, dried fruit and more integrated tannin with age.

stages.label: Young
stages.effect: Blackcurrant, plum, cedar and graphite dominate; tannin and acidity can feel strict.

stages.label: Developing
stages.effect: Fruit becomes less primary as tobacco, cedar, dried herbs and leather build complexity and the structure starts to soften.

stages.label: Mature
stages.effect: Dried black fruit, cigar box, earth, leather and savory notes can dominate, with tannin more resolved and texture more supple.

cabernet-sauvignon.vintage: Riper years can emphasize plush fruit and earlier accessibility; cooler or more classic years may feel firmer and develop more gradually.

tempranillo.summary: Bottle age pushes Rioja from red fruit and visible oak toward dried cherry, leather, tobacco, coconut and savory complexity, especially in Reserva and Gran Reserva styles.

stages.label: Young
stages.effect: Cherry and plum are prominent, with vanilla, cedar or coconut from oak and relatively fresh tannin.

stages.label: Developing
stages.effect: Dried red fruit, leather, tobacco and sweet spice become more obvious as oak and fruit integrate.

stages.label: Mature
stages.effect: Dried cherry, leather, tobacco, balsamic and earthy notes can dominate, with a softer, more harmonious texture.

tempranillo.vintage: Warm years tend to show fuller, riper fruit, while cooler years can preserve more freshness and savory detail. Ageing category and producer style matter as much as vintage.

cabernet-sauvignon.summary: Napa Cabernet usually begins with saturated black fruit and oak, then develops dried fruit, cedar, tobacco and cocoa as tannin softens and the wine becomes more savory.

stages.label: Young
stages.effect: Blackberry, cassis, plum, vanilla and cedar dominate over substantial tannin and body.

stages.label: Developing
stages.effect: Black fruit starts to feel less primary while cedar, cocoa, tobacco and dried-herb notes gain ground.

stages.label: Mature
stages.effect: Dried black fruit, cedar, tobacco, leather and savory spice can replace much of the youthful fruit intensity; tannin is typically more rounded.

cabernet-sauvignon.vintage: Hotter years often show greater ripeness and softer early structure; cooler years can retain more acidity and herbal detail and may need more time to integrate.

pinot-noir.summary: Ageing Burgundy Pinot Noir can move from red berries and floral lift toward dried cherry, mushroom, forest floor, spice and game while remaining relatively light in body.

stages.label: Young
stages.effect: Red cherry, cranberry and violet lead, with bright acidity and relatively fine but noticeable tannin.

stages.label: Developing
stages.effect: Fruit turns more savory and less fresh as mushroom, spice and forest-floor notes emerge.

stages.label: Mature
stages.effect: Dried red fruit, earth, mushroom, tea and game can dominate, with a softer, silkier structure.

pinot-noir.vintage: Warmer years often show more generous fruit and earlier openness; cooler years can be more delicate, acidic and slow to reveal secondary complexity.

xinomavro.summary: Xinomavro can evolve strikingly from tart red fruit, tomato and fierce tannin toward dried fruit, olive, leather, spice and earthy complexity.

stages.label: Young
stages.effect: Sour cherry, red plum, tomato and herbal notes sit over high acidity and assertive tannin.

stages.label: Developing
stages.effect: Dried tomato, olive, leather and spice begin to build while the tannin becomes less severe.

stages.label: Mature
stages.effect: Dried red fruit, olive, leather, earth and savory spice can dominate, with a more integrated, Nebbiolo-like structure.

xinomavro.vintage: Warmer seasons generally give riper fruit and softer tannin; cooler seasons can accentuate acidity, herbal character and a slower path to maturity.

tannat.summary: Tannat's dense fruit and formidable tannin can mellow substantially with age, allowing leather, cocoa, tobacco and dried black fruit to come forward.

stages.label: Young
stages.effect: Blackberry and plum are intense, with very firm tannin and a compact, powerful feel.

stages.label: Developing
stages.effect: Tannin begins to soften as cocoa, tobacco, cedar and dried-fruit notes become more visible.

stages.label: Mature
stages.effect: Dried black fruit, leather, tobacco and earthy notes can dominate, with a rounder, less austere texture.

tannat.vintage: Riper years may soften Tannat's structure sooner, while cooler years can preserve more acidity and prolong the wine's firm phase.

touriga-nacional.summary: Ageing dry Touriga Nacional can move from intense black fruit, violet and firm structure toward dried fruit, cedar, cocoa, tobacco and floral-spice complexity.

stages.label: Young
stages.effect: Blackberry, plum and violet dominate, with concentrated body and substantial tannin.

stages.label: Developing
stages.effect: Fruit becomes less primary as cedar, cocoa, dried herbs and spice increase and the tannin integrates.

stages.label: Mature
stages.effect: Dried dark fruit, tobacco, leather, cocoa and floral-spice notes can dominate with a smoother texture.

touriga-nacional.vintage: Hot, dry years can emphasize concentration and ripe fruit; fresher years may retain more lift and take longer to lose their youthful structure.
